premises.text: Fast-growing software teams waste productivity on mismatched dev/prod environments, long test waits, and build breaks that block the whole team
premises.evidence_span: our development environments never matched up with our production environments

premises.text: Quality platform isolates each push in limbo, spins production-like cloud replicas (including behind firewall), and runs automation tests in massive parallel so broken builds never reach the team
premises.evidence_span: takes that change and holds it in a limbo state

premises.text: Making existing engineers ~20% more effective yields free capacity equivalent to several new hires without recruiting/training cost
premises.evidence_span: quality can make your development team 20% more effective

premises.text: Productized Quality replaces millions spent on internal Google/Facebook-style testing infra so ordinary companies can buy rather than build
premises.evidence_span: You can now buy the quality product

notes: Three standout pains (env mismatch, slow tests, build breaks) folded as one engineering-productivity problem set (§4.1.6). Limbo isolation, prod replicas, and parallel test chunking folded as one Quality platform mechanism (§4.1.7). Customer test-time charts treated as traction evidence for that mechanism. 20% effectiveness and buy-vs-build GTM coded as separately asserted commercial paths. Palantir bio excluded. Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
